title: Bosphorus Short Circle Sightseeing Cruise
description: The classic first taste of Istanbul from the water — a relaxed 2-hour daytime cruise departing from Eminönü, gliding past Dolmabahçe Palace, Ortaköy Mosque, and the Bosphorus Bridge with multilingual audio commentary.
imageAlt: Ortakoy Mosque on the Bosphorus strait in Istanbul during the day
bestFor: First-time visitors who want the classic view in under half a day

title: Full Bosphorus Cruise to Anadolu Kavağı
description: The complete daytime Bosphorus experience — a 6-hour round trip all the way to Anadolu Kavağı, the fishing village at the Black Sea entrance, with free time ashore to explore or hike up to Yoros Castle before the return cruise.
includes: 2–3 hours free time at Anadolu Kavağı
imageAlt: Dolmabahce Palace on the Bosphorus shoreline in Istanbul during the day
bestFor: Travelers with a full day who want to see the whole strait, end to end

title: Bosphorus Cruise with Onboard Lunch
description: Combine the sightseeing cruise with a relaxed Turkish lunch on board — a slower-paced afternoon way to enjoy the Bosphorus while sampling mezze and grilled fish as the city drifts by.
imageAlt: Dolmabahce Palace along the Bosphorus in Istanbul in daylight
bestFor: Travelers who want sightseeing plus a real meal on the water

title: Bosphorus Cruise + Two Continents Afternoon Tour
description: See Istanbul from both the water and the road — a Bosphorus sightseeing cruise paired with an afternoon minibus tour crossing between the European and Asian sides, with stops at Camlica Hill and the Bosphorus Bridge viewpoint.
imageAlt: A domed waterfront tower on the Bosphorus strait in Istanbul during the day
bestFor: First-timers who want the strait and both continents in one afternoon
